title: CS2023 defines foundational programming and software-development competencies
locator: Software Development Fundamentals (SDF), Preamble and Knowledge Units
paraphrase: CS2023 positions reading and writing programs, using fundamental programming concepts and data structures, applying development practices, testing, debugging, and reasoning about program quality and performance as early software-development foundations.
scope: Curriculum evidence for Volume 01 programming, data, control-flow, function, collection, text, error, debugging, and testing concepts; language-specific semantics require a language specification.
